title: Guess the Permutation
statementMd:
Bob has a permutation of integers from $1$ to $*n*$. Denote this permutation as $*p*$. The $*i*$-th element of $*p*$ will be denoted as $*p*_{*i*}$. For all pairs of distinct integers $*i*, *j*$ between $1$ and $*n*$, he wrote the number $*a*_{*i*, *j*} = *min*(*p*_{*i*}, *p*_{*j*})$. He writes $*a*_{*i*, *i*} = 0$ for all integer $*i*$ from $1$ to $*n*$.

Bob gave you all the values of $*a*_{*i*, *j*}$ that he wrote down. Your job is to reconstruct any permutation that could have generated these values. The input will be formed so that it is guaranteed that there is at least one solution that is consistent with the information given.

## Input

The first line of the input will contain a single integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 50$).

The next $*n*$ lines will contain the values of $*a*_{*i*, *j*}$. The $*j*$-th number on the $*i*$-th line will represent $*a*_{*i*, *j*}$. The $*i*$-th number on the $*i*$-th line will be $0$. It's guaranteed that $*a*_{*i*, *j*} = *a*_{*j*, *i*}$ and there is at least one solution consistent with the information given.

## Output

Print $*n*$ space separated integers, which represents a permutation that could have generated these values. If there are multiple possible solutions, print any of them.

## Note

In the first case, the answer can be ${1, 2}$ or ${2, 1}$.

In the second case, another possible answer is ${2, 4, 5, 1, 3}$.
statementZhMd:
Bob 有一个由 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 组成的排列。将该排列记为 $*p*$。$*p*$ 的第 $*i*$ 个元素记为 $*p*_{*i*}$。对于 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 之间任意一对不同的整数 $*i*, *j*$，他记录了数字 $*a*_{*i*, *j*} = *min*(*p*_{*i*}, *p*_{*j*})$。对于 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 之间的所有整数 $*i*$，他记录 $*a*_{*i*, *i*} = 0$。

Bob 将他记录的所有 $*a*_{*i*, *j*}$ 的值都给了你。你的任务是还原出任意一个能够生成这些值的排列。输入数据保证至少存在一个与所给信息一致的解。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 50$）。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行包含 $*a*_{*i*, *j*}$ 的值。第 $*i*$ 行的第 $*j*$ 个数表示 $*a*_{*i*, *j*}$。第 $*i*$ 行的第 $*i*$ 个数为 $0$。保证 $*a*_{*i*, *j*} = *a*_{*j*, *i*}$，并且至少存在一个与所给信息一致的解。

## 输出格式

输出 $*n*$ 个由空格分隔的整数，表示一个能够生成这些值的排列。如果有多个可能的解，输出其中任意一个即可。

## 说明

在第一种情况中，答案可以是 ${1, 2}$ 或 ${2, 1}$。

在第二种情况中，${2, 4, 5, 1, 3}$ 也是一种可能的答案。
